name: keepwarm-bg
description: A mod that keeps the prompt cache warm while the session waits on background work (shells, subagents, monitors, workflows): 50 idle minutes after a turn that leaves work in flight it sends one cache-reading fork, every 50 minutes, for at most 12 hours after the last turn. It runs no slash commands and leaves nothing in the transcript: the countdown and the last ping show in a row above the prompt, each ping in a toast, and pings stopping early in a notification. It stays out of the way of a cache-tax /keepwarm window.
